redRegressions.before: Expired concurrent recovery committed FAILED or COMPENSATION_REQUIRED while an earlier payment or delivery was still in flight.
redRegressions.after: Repository exclusion covers the entire begin/advance call, including inspection, authorization, provider invocation and persisted replacement.

redRegressions.before: Repository create accepted non-initial states; replacement accepted changed request/permit and skipped or reopened transaction legs.
redRegressions.after: New records require PREPARED/revision zero/empty reason; replacements preserve identity and authorization and enforce the current state graph.

failureMatrix: Payment in flight + expired concurrent recovery: wait, recover payment, then compensate exactly once.
Delivery in flight + expired concurrent recovery: wait, observe completed delivery, never refund delivered items.
Concurrent begin with an expired retry returns the original persisted saga and authorizes only once.
Different lock stripes can advance through one repository while another provider call is blocked.
Payment applied but file write fails: original bytes remain; restart after expiry recovers and refunds once.
Delivery applied but file write fails: restart after expiry completes without refund.
Refund applied but file write fails: restart queries the key and does not refund twice.
Callback failure releases the OS lock and thread-local scope; same-saga nesting works and cross-saga nesting rejects.
Repositories without the stronger exclusive-execution contract reject before authorization or side effects.
